materialityPolicies.Notes: Overall close materiality used for prioritization.
Transactions within seven days of 12/31 receive higher cutoff risk.
Items above threshold receive elevated valuation risk.
Naive model reviews every inventory record.

exceptions.Title: Customer Deployment / Cutoff
exceptions.Summary: ERP shows warehouse while carrier, installation, and telemetry evidence place the device at the customer before year-end.

exceptions.Title: Vendor Goods in Transit
exceptions.Summary: Vendor shipped before year-end and warehouse received after year-end; ownership depends on contractual shipping terms.

exceptions.Title: RMA Double Count
exceptions.Summary: Original RMA unit and replacement are both included in available inventory.

exceptions.Title: Obsolescence Review
exceptions.Summary: Aging, reduced demand, and newer edge models indicate a reserve review is warranted.

exceptions.Title: Demo / Loaner Classification
exceptions.Summary: Device is active at a prospect site and remains company-owned, but ERP classification is inconsistent.

exceptions.Title: Customer Shipment Crossing Year-End
exceptions.Summary: Shipment and invoicing straddle year-end; contract terms are needed before a cutoff conclusion.

exceptions.Title: Serial/Shipment Mismatch
exceptions.Summary: Multiple evidence sources required review; premium analysis resolved the issue without a material adjustment.
